item.title: Bastidas Soccer Academy Training Camp — Thu Aug 27, 9:00 AM — Manheim Central Middle School
item.description:
Established in 1999, the Bastidas Soccer Academy emphasizes the importance of basic skill and ball mastery. We are passionate about teaching you to have fun and develop a winning attitude. All boys and girls from any school or district, entering grades 3-8, are invited to attend this premier camp to kick off the fall season. Registration is $200 per player (or $190 each for a sibling group) and will include:
Camp T-shirt USSF Licensed Coaches (including “A” License coach Trajano Bastidas) and USYS ODP Coaches Camp features– league play, king of the hill, soccer dance, small sided games, stations Main focuses– first touch, passing, receiving, finishing, having fun!
Players should arrive at least 10 minutes early each day with proper attire, sneakers, cleats, shin guards, plenty of water, and a snack for the mid-point break. Questions? item.title: Advanced Ride (B) BI Three Friends (36H) — Sat Aug 29, 8:00 AM
item.description:
Lancaster Bicycle Club (LBC) Meetup ***Be Safe, Have Fun, and Ride Together***
Ride leader: Dan Maier Anticipated Average Pace: 16-18 mph Route: https://ridewithgps.com/routes/40246028
This is a B level ride. The ride leader will ride at the advertised average speed. This is intended to be a group ride with a no-drop rule as the main goal. The ride leader will do his/her best to keep the group together with occasional regroupings and a sweeper may also be appointed at the start. Please do not join this ride if you are not willing to ride with the group. If you exceed the posted pace, you will be riding by yourself and encouraged to join a faster group. If maintaining a 16-18 mph average is beyond your current ability level, please consider joining a slower ride first.
Helmets are mandatory. No earbuds. Please bring water and a basic repair kit (spare tube, tire levers, pump/CO2 inflator).
To eliminate passing around a pen and paper waiver, we require LBC Club membership and Meetup

item.title: Valley Forge Park River Trail (Pawlings Rd) — Sun Aug 30, 10:00 AM
item.description:
Walking Tails Directions: From the intersection of Egypt Road and Park Ave./Pawlings Road, proceed on Pawlings Road heading towards the Schuylkill River. You will pass Mill Grove on your right, St. Gabriel Hall on your left and Pawling Farm on your left. You are getting close when you pass Sullivan Blvd. on your left and Gertrude St. on your right. You turn left on the next and last left (right before you go over the bridge over the Schuylkill River). Look for the River Trail Valley Forge Park sign visible from Pawlings Road. The gravel parking lot is straight ahead and also visible from Pawlings Road. If you go over the bridge over the Schuylkill River, you have gone too far and are now in Chester county.
CLICK DIRECTLY ON THE MAP IF YOU THINK YOU ARE LOST. IT WILL BRING YOU RIGHT TO US WHERE WE MEET.
This walk goes out about 1.5 miles along the Schuylkill River and then we come back the way we came, for a total of 3 miles. This is a dirt/gravel/mulch trail through the woods.

item.title: Crochet with Kasey - Chaos Blanket — Tue Sep 8, 6:30 PM — Columbia
item.description:
Arts & Crafts, Teens, Adults, Seniors
If you enjoy crafting and conversations, this class is for you! For September, October - and maybe November, they will be joining in on the TikTok viral trend of completing a Chaos Blanket, where the results of the project will be nothing short of a surprise. Supplies/What to Bring: Choose 5 colors - assign each color a number 1-5 and keep record of the number assigned to the color. You will need to reference this throughout the project. Ex: red - 1, blue - 2, pink - 3, etc. - this is part of the chaos fun!Hook - based on recommended size for yard being used (H/5mm, I/5.5MM typically works for most projects and yarn weight)Recommend worsted weight or light/sport wright yarn if making for babyScissorsStitch MarkersYarn NeedleSee right hand side of screen for printable PDF of materials and more information. This project is for experienced crocheters. Participants are also welcome to bring their own project to work on.

item.title: Lancaster Scrapbooking & Papercrafting Monthly gathering — Tue Sep 15, 6:00 PM
item.description: Lancaster Scrapbooking, Cards & Papercrafts Scrapbook, make cards, practice quilling, or paint! Meeting on the third Tuesday, 6-10 p.m., at the Cozy Crop House. (Also meeting the next night, Wednesday, same time & place. You can come to one or both, and can leave your gear overnight.)
